title: finding(release): `changeset-release.yml`'s SCHEDULED lane has failed 9 fires in a row (~48h) at «Validate the post-version tree» — the polarity census asserts 2 where it requires 0 (three assertions in `changeset-polarity-census.test.ts`), so publish and the version-PR refresh are skipped while every push fire stays green because that job is SKIPPED there
body:
`.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`'s **scheduled** lane has failed 5 consecutive fires over
~24h, at step 14 「Validate the post-version tree」. Every `push` fire of the same workflow in the same
window is green, so no push-driven signal shows it and nobody has been told. Publish, changeset
clearing and 「Refresh the version PR」 were all **skipped** on each of those runs.

Found by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat at 2026-09-19T10:08Z while reading a half-state patrol row
(H57, scheduled non-blocking workflows) that had been invisible to this seat until today — see the
last section. ⛔ This seat does ⛔ not run releases, ⛔ not re-run this workflow and ⛔ not grade or
route this card.

## The streak, measured on the workflow's own run list

`event=schedule` fires only, newest first:

| fire <sub>read 2026-09-19T10:08Z</sub> | conclusion |
|:--|:--|
| 2026-09-19T06:11:55Z (run `35425956496`) | **failure** |
| 2026-09-19T00:20:05Z | **failure** |
| 2026-09-18T18:08:34Z | **failure** |
| 2026-09-18T12:10:58Z | **failure** |
| 2026-09-18T06:12:48Z | **failure** |
| 2026-09-18T00:20:11Z … 2026-09-16T06:13:21Z | success ×8 |
| 2026-09-16T00:19:46Z … 2026-09-12T00:19:28Z | **failure ×17** |

⇒ not a one-off: a ~17-fire red stretch, a ~2-day green window, and the current 5-fire streak.
Declared schedule is `0 */6 * * *`.

⭐ **CONTROL, and it is the reason nobody saw this**: every `push` fire of the SAME workflow in the
current streak's window is `success` — `35436005979` (09:55Z), `35434070781` (09:12Z),
`35432852618` (08:45Z), `35424341592` (05:35Z) and so on. The workflow is not broken in general; the
**scheduled lane** is. A reader watching pull requests, merges or `main` sees nothing.

## Where it stops, and what gets skipped

Run `35425956496`, job `105851827568` (`Changeset Release`). Step-by-step:

| step | conclusion |
|:--|:--|
| 1–9 (set up → Build packages) | success |
| 10 Clear pending changesets for the publish branch | **skipped** |
| 11 Publish to npm | **skipped** |
| 12 Verify the release reached npm | **skipped** |
| 13 Render the post-version tree | success |
| **14 Validate the post-version tree** | **FAILURE** |
| 15 Restore the pre-version tree | success — `Pre-version tree restored: 1764 pending changeset(s), working tree clean.` |
| 16 Refresh the version PR | **skipped** |

⇒ the guard is doing its job — it stops before publishing and restores the tree cleanly. The cost is
that the version PR is not refreshed on this lane, and the pending count sits at **1764**.

## ⭐ The failure is a CONTROL failure, by the instrument's own contract

Step 14 runs a suite; `1 test file failed / 174 passed (177)`, `3 tests failed / 5232 passed (5237)`.
All three failures are in `scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts` — `:366:44`,
`:385:28` and `:991:44` — and all three read identically:

```
AssertionError: expected 2 to be +0 // Object.is equality
- 0
+ 2
```

The assertions are on the census process's **exit status** (`expect(outcome.status, outcome.stderr).toBe(0)`).
And `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs`'s own header states what each status means, verbatim:

> Exit: 0 = the census ran (findings do NOT fail it -- report-only by design)
>       1 = an input could not be read, so this run MEASURED NOTHING
>       2 = a control failed, so this run's zeros are not evidence of absence

⇒ **exit 2 = a control failed.** ⛔ This is NOT the census finding offending changesets — findings are
explicitly report-only and do not fail it. It is the instrument declaring that its own zeros are not
evidence of absence, and the release lane correctly refusing to proceed on a reading that cannot be
trusted.

⚠️ **WHICH control fails is NOT measured here.** This seat tried to run the census on the shared
checkout and got `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'typescript'` — exit 1 for a different
reason (no installed dependencies), ⛔ not a reproduction. The owning lane runs
`pnpm census:changeset-polarity` in an installed tree and reads the `Controls PASS` line the test at
`:992` expects; the census prints which control failed. ⛔ Do not infer it from this card.

## ⛔ What this seat did NOT do

⛔ Did not re-run the workflow. ⛔ Did not run any release or version action. ⛔ Did not touch
`.changeset/`. The red lines are explicit that release actions are the maintainer's, that a mechanical
channel existing is not authorisation, and that this seat never runs a remedial release.

## Why it was invisible, and the instrument that finally saw it

The half-state patrol's H57 row exists exactly for this shape — a scheduled, non-blocking workflow
whose latest `event=schedule` run is red, on the ground that 「a workflow that dies cannot report its
own death」. That row read **NOTHING** on this board in this seat's three sweeps today, because
`check-half-states.mjs` resolves the local checkout from `process.cwd()` rather than from
`PM_SWEEP_REPO` — filed as objectstack#19191. Re-run from the objectui checkout, H57 judged 8 of 10
scheduled workflows and produced this row on its first pass. ⇒ this card is the first thing that
finding bought.

Dedupe words: `changeset-release scheduled lane failure` · `Validate the post-version tree` ·
`changeset-polarity-census exit 2 control` · `version PR not refreshed schedule` ·
`changeset release cron red`


## ⚠️ 修好它会**关上另一张卡的单向门** —— 排序事实,请在动手前读一眼

⭐ **objectui#10019 在这条红线后面等着。** 那张卡记的是:`.changeset/9232-cache-approval-envelope.md`
这条 **pending** changeset 的正文里有一句枚举,在 PR objectui#10017 合并(2026-09-19T12:22:53Z)之后
**已经确凿过时**;而它会在**下一次发布**时原样publish进 `CHANGELOG`,其后 `AGENTS.md` 第 11 诫禁止再改。

⇒ 今天挡住那次发布的,正是**这条红线**。⭐ 这条线一被修好,下一次定时 fire 就会把那段错文字封存。

⛔ 这**不是**要求任何人推迟修这条线 —— 一个缺陷替另一张卡挡门,不是计划。是要求:**修这条线的人
知道门后面有东西**,并在恢复绿之前(或同一批里)让 objectui#10019 落地。

⚠️ objectui#10019 今天**无法被认领**:它只有 `finding` 标签,⛔ 无 `domain:*`、⛔ 无定级,而分诊席空缺
(objectstack#6015)。⇒ 这条排序事实写在这里,是因为它现在没有别的地方可以被读到。
